fragment.claim_boundary: This decision authorizes only one pre-application overlay trial for the exact revision110 blind-holder Task Evaluate unit. It is not Candidate activation, a live forecast, production routing, independent external capability, AGI evidence, or user-level completion.

fragment.selected_strategy: one-call Candidate overlay trial over unchanged active Task Evaluate baseline

observations: A fail-closed synthetic protocol gate may pass while live forecast capability and the unchanged upper objective remain unproven, so both verdicts and evidence scopes must stay explicit.
Pre-application relevance and prior PROPOSE_ACTIVATION evidence authorize only this scoped overlay trial, not Candidate promotion, same-session isolation acceptance, or generalized claims.

result.applicability: Directly applicable only to the exact upcoming Task Evaluate call because it adds a separately falsifiable bounded-unit verdict while preserving the unchanged upper-objective verdict.
result.baseline_need: Keep the active Task Evaluate contract unchanged as the baseline. The scoped overlay may add only a unit_verdict for the exact repository-local blind-holder protocol unit and must not relax, replace, or convert the upper-objective verdict.

cost_dimensions.token: Small bounded overlay cost; record only directly measured usage if available.

A one-call TRIAL_CANDIDATE therefore tests its additive dual-verdict discipline against the unchanged active baseline without promotion or self-activation.

positive fixture and suite replay are byte-stable and all 14 negative controls fail for their unique expected reasons
same-session or unverified-model self-attestation is never accepted as predictor isolation

result.rollback: If the overlay omits either verdict, conflates their scopes, accepts any failed isolation/order/digest/replay/baseline control, relabels the prior contaminated trial, widens a claim, suppresses negative evidence, or changes the active Task Evaluate baseline, discard the overlay result for this scope, retain the active prompt result and all evidence, and leave the Candidate unactivated.
